description: Diagnose why the Brace reaction popup does not appear when Brace should be available, using the canonical toolchain diagnostics before authoring any mutation.
planning_goal: Trace the Brace reaction from its triggering runtime signal through reaction eligibility, native/system integration, and popup presentation. Identify the smallest owned repair that makes the Brace reaction popup appear when its existing eligibility rules say it should, without changing Brace rules or unrelated reactions.

scope_lock.original_user_instruction: Try to fix the brace reaction pop up window not appearing when it should. Lets see if the scope lock helps at all
authorized_deliverables: Diagnose why the Brace reaction popup does not appear when Brace should be available.
Repair only the owned runtime/presentation seam necessary to make the Brace popup appear under its existing eligibility rules.
forbidden_expansions: Do not change Brace game rules, costs, effects, or eligibility semantics.
Do not change unrelated reactions or actions.
Do not redesign reaction UI or other presentation surfaces.
Do not modify developer tooling, GitHub workflows, or repository infrastructure.
Do not perform adjacent cleanup or refactors.

acceptance_criteria: Canonical diagnostics identify the runtime signal that should cause Brace reaction consideration.
Canonical diagnostics identify the existing Brace eligibility path and popup/presentation path.
The repair is limited to the smallest certified ownership surface responsible for the missing popup.
Brace popup appears when existing Brace eligibility rules say Brace is available.
Brace popup does not appear when existing Brace eligibility rules say Brace is unavailable.
Brace mechanics and unrelated reactions remain unchanged.
